{{Quote|The anti-virus is actually easily synthesized. It was created by....it was originally based on my immunity and synthesized by my assistant aboard the prison barge.|[[Zahara Cody]]|<ref name="SWG:GI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Get Inoculated|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
This '''anti-virus''' was developed by [[Chief medical officer]] [[Zahara Cody]] aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prison ship/Legends|prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] to prevent the infection of the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]].<ref name="DT">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref> The anti-virus was later used during the [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:GI" />
